name: jimao-3a-mobile
description: 几猫3A大作 手机壳层：PWA 站点 + Capacitor 原生壳

scripts.platforms: npx cap add android && npx cap add ios && node post-add.mjs
scripts.sync: node build.mjs && npx cap sync && node post-add.mjs
scripts.apk: node build.mjs && npx cap sync android && node post-add.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --no-daemon
scripts.android: node build.mjs && npx cap sync android && node post-add.mjs && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node build.mjs && npx cap sync ios && node post-add.mjs && npx cap open ios
